quote: ADC of dry matter (ADC DM) at four meals per day was significantly lower than at two meals per day
statement: 每日四次投喂的干物质表观消化系数显著低于每日两次投喂。
text_zh: 每日四次投喂的干物质表观消化系数显著低于每日两次投喂。
text_en: The apparent digestibility coefficient of dry matter for feeding four times daily was significantly lower than that for feeding twice daily.

quote: The expression levels of casr and gprc6a in the intestine were significantly up-regulated at four meals per day compared to two meals per day (P Table 4).
statement: 与每天两餐相比，每天四餐显著上调了肠道中casr和gprc6a的表达水平。
text_zh: 与每天两餐相比，每天四餐显著上调了肠道中casr和gprc6a的表达水平。
text_en: Compared with two meals per day, four meals per day significantly upregulated the expression levels of casr and gprc6a in the intestine.

quote: Feeding frequency and diet significantly interacted with the transcript levels of t1r3 and mglur4 (P Fig. 1 B).
statement: 投喂频率和日粮对t1r3和mglur4的转录水平有显著的交互作用。
text_zh: 投喂频率和日粮对t1r3和mglur4的转录水平有显著的交互作用。
text_en: Feeding frequency and diet had a significant interaction effect on the transcription levels of t1r3 and mglur4.

quote: While the mechanisms of these effects remain unclear, in many cases higher stomach enzyme activity and the increased availabil-ity of energy carried by organic acids were identified as possible factors.
statement: 酸化饲料的机制尚不清楚，但在许多情况下，胃酶活性升高和有机酸携带的能量可用性增加被认为是可能的因素。
text_zh: 酸化饲料的机制尚不清楚，但在许多情况下，胃酶活性升高和有机酸携带的能量可用性增加被认为是可能的因素。
text_en: The mechanism of acidified feed is not yet clear, but in many cases, increased gastric enzyme activity and the increased availability of energy carried by organic acids are considered possible factors.

quote: Since C. carassius food is digested at a pH range of 6.50–7.61 (Solovyev et al. 2018), acidi-fying diets for this species might not increase enzyme activity.
statement: 由于鲫鱼的食物在6.50–7.61的pH范围内消化，对该物种进行饲料酸化可能不会增加酶活性。
text_zh: 由于鲫鱼的食物在6.50–7.61的pH范围内消化，对该物种进行饲料酸化可能不会增加酶活性。
text_en: Since the feed of crucian carp is digested in a pH range of 6.50–7.61, feed acidification for this species may not increase enzyme activity.
counterevidence: 天然消化pH范围较窄且偏中性

quote: Fish meal is often a P-rich, major ingredient of commer-cial feeds for these animals that contains high amounts of P bound in secondary and tertiary cal-cium phosphates, which is poorly absorbed by stomachless cyprinid fish species (Ogino et al. 1979).
statement: 鱼粉通常是这些动物商业饲料中富含磷的主要成分，含有大量结合在次级和三级磷酸钙中的磷，而无胃鲤科鱼类对此吸收不良。
text_zh: 鱼粉通常是这些动物商业饲料中富含磷的主要成分，含有大量结合在次级和三级磷酸钙中的磷，而无胃鲤科鱼类对此吸收不良。
text_en: Fish meal is usually the main phosphorus-rich ingredient in commercial feed for these animals, containing large amounts of phosphorus bound in secondary and tertiary calcium phosphate, which agastric cyprinid fish absorb poorly.

population.species: 无胃鲤科鱼类 (stomachless cyprinid fish species)

quote: Therefore, the low availability of dietary P can cause deficiencies of this element in fishes.
statement: 因此，膳食磷的低可用性会导致鱼类缺乏这种元素。
text_zh: 因此，膳食磷的低可用性会导致鱼类缺乏这种元素。
text_en: Therefore, low availability of dietary phosphorus leads to a deficiency of this element in fish.

quote: Long term P deficiency in fishes can, in turn, induce body deformities.
statement: 鱼类长期磷缺乏反过来会诱发身体畸形。
text_zh: 鱼类长期磷缺乏反过来会诱发身体畸形。
text_en: Long-term phosphorus deficiency in fish can conversely induce body deformities.

quote: In numerous feeding trials lasting 60 days or lon-ger, high shares of body deformities were detected in cyprinid fish species prone to deformities that were fed intensively with commercial diets under con-trolled conditions (Myszkowski et al. 2002, Wolnicki 2005, Kamler et al. 2006, 2008, González-Rodríguez et al. 2014, Kamiñski et al. 2017).
statement: 在许多持续60天或更长时间的饲养试验中，在受控条件下用商业饲料密集喂养的易患畸形的鲤科鱼类中检测到高比例的身体畸形。
text_zh: 在许多持续60天或更长时间的饲养试验中，在受控条件下用商业饲料密集喂养的易患畸形的鲤科鱼类中检测到高比例的身体畸形。
text_en: In many feeding trials lasting 60 days or longer, a high proportion of body deformities was detected in cyprinid fish prone to deformities that were intensively fed commercial feed under controlled conditions.

quote: All fish were fed up to apparent satiation with control diets thrice a day (07:00, 12:00, 17:30) for two weeks.
statement: 所有鱼在两周内每天三次（07:00, 12:00, 17:30）饲喂对照日粮至表观饱食。
text_zh: 所有鱼在两周内每天三次（07:00, 12:00, 17:30）饲喂对照日粮至表观饱食。
text_en: All fish were fed the control diet to apparent satiation three times daily (07:00, 12:00, 17:30) for two weeks.

quote: Then all the fish were fasted for 24 h.
statement: 随后所有鱼禁食24小时。
text_zh: 随后所有鱼禁食24小时。
text_en: All fish were then fasted for 24 hours.

quote: Table 5 Growth performance and feed utilization indices of gibel carp fed the experimental diets with different feeding frequencies.
statement: 表5展示了不同投喂频率下实验日粮对银鲫生长性能和饲料利用指标的影响。
text_zh: 表5展示了不同投喂频率下实验日粮对银鲫生长性能和饲料利用指标的影响。
text_en: Table 5 shows the effects of experimental diets on growth performance and feed utilization indicators of gibel carp under different feeding frequencies.

statement: 各处理组的存活率（SR）在96.67%至98.33%之间，且统计检验显示无显著差异。
text_zh: 各处理组的存活率（SR）在96.67%至98.33%之间，且统计检验显示无显著差异。
text_en: The survival rate (SR) in each treatment group was between 96.67% and 98.33%, and statistical tests showed no significant difference.

statement: 高频率投喂组（HF）的摄食量（FI）约为19.4-19.8 g/kg MBW/day，高于低频率投喂组（LF）的13.7-14.7 g/kg MBW/day。
text_zh: 高频率投喂组（HF）的摄食量（FI）约为19.4-19.8 g/kg MBW/day，高于低频率投喂组（LF）的13.7-14.7 g/kg MBW/day。
text_en: The feed intake (FI) of the high-frequency feeding group (HF) was about 19.4-19.8 g/kg MBW/day, higher than that of the low-frequency feeding group (LF) at 13.7-14.7 g/kg MBW/day.

statement: 饲料效率（FE）在低频投喂组中较高（约60-72%），而在高频投喂组中较低（约51-54%）。
text_zh: 饲料效率（FE）在低频投喂组中较高（约60-72%），而在高频投喂组中较低（约51-54%）。
text_en: Feed efficiency (FE) was higher in the low-frequency feeding group (about 60-72%) and lower in the high-frequency feeding group (about 51-54%).
counterevidence: 高频投喂导致饲料效率降低

quote: Therefore, the strategies of a reasonable increase in feeding frequency and appropriate mixing of different protein sources can be used to cope with the insufficient supply of fishmeal in aquaculture.
statement: 增加投喂频率和混合不同蛋白源的策略可用于应对水产养殖中鱼粉供应不足的问题。
text_zh: 增加投喂频率和混合不同蛋白源的策略可用于应对水产养殖中鱼粉供应不足的问题。
text_en: Increasing feeding frequency and mixing different protein sources can be used to address the shortage of fishmeal supply in aquaculture.
intervention: Higher feeding frequency with mixed protein sources

quote: o32 (P s6k1 was down-regulated significantly and foxo1 and fbxo32 was up-regulated significantly at two meals per day
statement: 在每日两餐的饲喂频率下，s6k1基因显著下调，而foxo1和fbxo32基因显著上调。
text_zh: 在每日两餐的饲喂频率下，s6k1基因显著下调，而foxo1和fbxo32基因显著上调。
text_en: Under a feeding frequency of two meals per day, the s6k1 gene was significantly downregulated, while the foxo1 and fbxo32 genes were significantly upregulated.
outcome: 肌肉蛋白合成与降解相关基因表达

quote: SGR (except for diet 4) increased in fish fed to satiation at four meals per day compared to two meals per day, while FE and PRE decreased.
statement: 与每日两餐相比，每日四餐饱食投喂的鱼（除饲料4外）比生长率增加，但饲料效率和蛋白质效率降低。
text_zh: 与每日两餐相比，每日四餐饱食投喂的鱼（除饲料4外）比生长率增加，但饲料效率和蛋白质效率降低。
text_en: Compared to two meals per day, fish fed to satiation four times a day (except for feed 4) had an increased specific growth rate, but reduced feed efficiency and protein efficiency.
outcome: 生长性能与饲料利用效率

quote: Increasing feeding frequency with quantitative feeding, which is not adopted in the present trial, holds considerable potential in enhancing growth performance by promoting feed utilization (Biswas et al., 2023 ; Ding et al., 2017).
statement: 增加定量投喂的投喂频率具有通过促进饲料利用率来提高生长性能的潜力。
text_zh: 增加定量投喂的投喂频率具有通过促进饲料利用率来提高生长性能的潜力。
text_en: Increasing the feeding frequency of quantitative feeding has the potential to improve growth performance by promoting feed utilization.
intervention: More frequent feeding with quantitative feeding
intervention_record: 增加投喂频率结合定量投喂

quote: In our study, nutrient ADC decreased in fish fed at four meals per day compared to two meals per day.
statement: 在本研究中，与每天投喂两次相比，每天投喂四次的鱼的营养物质表观消化率降低。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与每天投喂两次相比，每天投喂四次的鱼的营养物质表观消化率降低。
text_en: In this study, the apparent digestibility of nutrients in fish fed four times a day was lower compared to those fed twice a day.

quote: Poor nutrient digestibility in aquaculture animals was not conducive to feed utilization (Hernández et al., 2021 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Poolsawat et al., 2021).
statement: 水产养殖动物较差的营养物质消化率不利于饲料利用。
text_zh: 水产养殖动物较差的营养物质消化率不利于饲料利用。
text_en: Poor nutrient digestibility in farmed aquatic animals is detrimental to feed utilization.

quote: In gilthead seabream, ADC CP increased with feeding frequency from one to three meals per day, which subsequently declined with further increase to six meals per day (Gilannejad et al., 2019).
statement: 在金头鲷中，随着投喂频率从每天一次增加到三次，粗蛋白表观消化率增加，随后进一步增加到每天六次时下降。
text_zh: 在金头鲷中，随着投喂频率从每天一次增加到三次，粗蛋白表观消化率增加，随后进一步增加到每天六次时下降。
text_en: In gilthead seabream, apparent digestibility of crude protein increased as feeding frequency was raised from once to three times per day, then decreased with a further increase to six times per day.

quote: different feeding frequencies (%)
statement: 表8展示了不同投喂频率下的数据。
text_zh: 表8展示了不同投喂频率下的数据。
text_en: Table 8 shows data under different feeding frequencies.

statement: 在低频率组中，LF4的粗蛋白数值显著低于其他低频率组；在高频率组中，HF1的粗蛋白数值最低。
text_zh: 在低频率组中，LF4的粗蛋白数值显著低于其他低频率组；在高频率组中，HF1的粗蛋白数值最低。
text_en: In the low-frequency group, the crude protein value of LF4 was significantly lower than that of other low-frequency groups; in the high-frequency group, HF1 had the lowest crude protein value.

statement: 投喂频率对总能量有显著影响（P=0.001），其中LF3最高，HF4最低。
text_zh: 投喂频率对总能量有显著影响（P=0.001），其中LF3最高，HF4最低。
text_en: Feeding frequency had a significant effect on total energy (P=0.001), with LF3 being the highest and HF4 the lowest.

statement: 总必需氨基酸（TEAA）的数值随投喂频率变化，LF3最高，HF1最低。
text_zh: 总必需氨基酸（TEAA）的数值随投喂频率变化，LF3最高，HF1最低。
text_en: The values of total essential amino acids (TEAA) varied with feeding frequency, being highest in LF3 and lowest in HF1.

statement: 蛋氨酸的消化率受投喂频率显著影响（P=0.001），高频率组中的HF1和HF4数值较低。
text_zh: 蛋氨酸的消化率受投喂频率显著影响（P=0.001），高频率组中的HF1和HF4数值较低。
text_en: The digestibility of methionine was significantly affected by feeding frequency (P=0.001), with lower values for HF1 and HF4 in the high-frequency group.

statement: 精氨酸的消化率受投喂频率（P=0.001）和日粮类型（P=0.005）以及二者交互作用的影响。
text_zh: 精氨酸的消化率受投喂频率（P=0.001）和日粮类型（P=0.005）以及二者交互作用的影响。
text_en: Arginine digestibility was affected by feeding frequency (P=0.001), diet type (P=0.005), and their interaction.

statement: 缬氨酸的消化率受投喂频率显著影响（P=0.001）。
text_zh: 缬氨酸的消化率受投喂频率显著影响（P=0.001）。
text_en: The digestibility of valine was significantly affected by feeding frequency (P=0.001).

statement: 苯丙氨酸的消化率受投喂频率显著影响（P=0.001）。
text_zh: 苯丙氨酸的消化率受投喂频率显著影响（P=0.001）。
text_en: The digestibility of phenylalanine was significantly affected by feeding frequency (P=0.001).

quote: ADC CP and ADC TEAA increased in fish fed with diet 3, indicating better digestion and absorption of protein.
statement: 饲料3组的粗蛋白表观消化率和总必需氨基酸表观消化率增加，表明蛋白质消化吸收更好。
text_zh: 饲料3组的粗蛋白表观消化率和总必需氨基酸表观消化率增加，表明蛋白质消化吸收更好。
text_en: The apparent digestibility of crude protein and total essential amino acids increased in the Feed 3 group, indicating better protein digestion and absorption.

quote: In addition, ADC TEAA in fish-fed diet 2 decreased at two meals per day but not at four meals per day, in line with results on growth performance.
statement: 饲料2组中，每日两餐投喂时总必需氨基酸表观消化率下降，而每日四餐投喂时未下降，这与生长性能结果一致。
text_zh: 饲料2组中，每日两餐投喂时总必需氨基酸表观消化率下降，而每日四餐投喂时未下降，这与生长性能结果一致。
text_en: In feed group 2, the apparent digestibility of total essential amino acids decreased with two daily meals but did not decrease with four daily meals, which is consistent with the growth performance results.
intervention: Two vs four meals per day

quote: The dietary DEAA of fish fed diet 3 or fed at two meals per day was closer to the muscle EAA profile, corroborating the results on feed utilization.
statement: 饲料3组或每日两餐投喂组的膳食可消化必需氨基酸谱更接近肌肉必需氨基酸谱，佐证了饲料利用率的结果。
text_zh: 饲料3组或每日两餐投喂组的膳食可消化必需氨基酸谱更接近肌肉必需氨基酸谱，佐证了饲料利用率的结果。
text_en: The dietary digestible essential amino acid profile of the Feed 3 group or the two-meals-per-day feeding group was closer to the muscle essential amino acid profile, supporting the results on feed utilization.
outcome: 氨基酸平衡与饲料利用

quote: In the present trial, trypsin activity and expression levels of pept1 and y + lat2 were up-regulated in fish fed four meals per day compared to two meals per day.
statement: 在本试验中，与每日两餐相比，每日四餐投喂鱼的胰蛋白酶活性以及pept1和y+lat2的表达水平上调。
text_zh: 在本试验中，与每日两餐相比，每日四餐投喂鱼的胰蛋白酶活性以及pept1和y+lat2的表达水平上调。
text_en: In this trial, compared with two meals per day, feeding fish four meals per day upregulated trypsin activity and the expression levels of pept1 and y+lat2.
intervention: Two vs four meals per day
outcome: 肠道消化酶活性与转运体表达

quote: Similarly in gilthead seabream, trypsin and chymotrypsin activities in the proximal intestine increased at higher feeding frequency (Busti et al., 2020), and expression levels of pept1 were up-regulated in the gastrointestinal tract with five meals per day or continuous feeding co
statement: 类似地，在金头鲷中，较高投喂频率下近端肠道的胰蛋白酶和糜蛋白酶活性增加，且每日五餐或连续投喂时胃肠道中pept1表达水平上调。
text_zh: 类似地，在金头鲷中，较高投喂频率下近端肠道的胰蛋白酶和糜蛋白酶活性增加，且每日五餐或连续投喂时胃肠道中pept1表达水平上调。
text_en: Similarly, in gilthead seabream, trypsin and chymotrypsin activities in the proximal intestine increased under higher feeding frequencies, and pept1 expression levels in the gastrointestinal tract were upregulated with five meals per day or continuous feeding.

quote: With feeding frequency increasing, the transcript levels of t1r3 in fish fed diets 1, 2 and 3, and the transcript levels of mglur4 in fish fed diets 1, 2, 3 and 4 were significantly up-regulated (P
statement: 随着投喂频率增加，饲喂日粮1、2和3的鱼中t1r3的转录水平以及饲喂日粮1、2、3和4的鱼中mglur4的转录水平显著上调。
text_zh: 随着投喂频率增加，饲喂日粮1、2和3的鱼中t1r3的转录水平以及饲喂日粮1、2、3和4的鱼中mglur4的转录水平显著上调。
text_en: As feeding frequency increased, the transcription levels of t1r3 in fish fed diets 1, 2, and 3, and the transcription levels of mglur4 in fish fed diets 1, 2, 3, and 4 were significantly upregulated.

quote: increasing feeding frequency significantly elevated FAA contents and AST activity in the muscle (P Table 4).
statement: 增加投喂频率显著提高了肌肉中的游离氨基酸（FAA）含量和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性。
text_zh: 增加投喂频率显著提高了肌肉中的游离氨基酸（FAA）含量和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性。
text_en: Increasing feeding frequency significantly increased the free amino acid (FAA) content and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) activity in muscle.

quote: Fish-fed diet 3 exhibited significantly higher FAA content compared to diets 1 and 2 (P = 0.017), while the activities of ALT and AST were significantly decreased in fish-fed diets 2, 3 and 4 compared to diet 1 (P
statement: 与日粮1和2相比，饲喂日粮3的鱼表现出显著更高的FAA含量，而与日粮1相比，饲喂日粮2、3和4的鱼的ALT和AST活性显著降低。
text_zh: 与日粮1和2相比，饲喂日粮3的鱼表现出显著更高的FAA含量，而与日粮1相比，饲喂日粮2、3和4的鱼的ALT和AST活性显著降低。
text_en: Compared to Diets 1 and 2, fish fed Diet 3 showed significantly higher FAA content, while compared to Diet 1, the ALT and AST activities of fish fed Diets 2, 3, and 4 were significantly lower.

quote: The transcript levels of akt1 in muscle were significantly up-regulated at four meals per day compared to two meals per day (P = 0.003).
statement: 与每天两餐相比，每天四餐显著上调了肌肉中akt1的转录水平。
text_zh: 与每天两餐相比，每天四餐显著上调了肌肉中akt1的转录水平。
text_en: Compared to two meals per day, four meals per day significantly upregulated the transcription level of akt1 in muscle.
outcome: 蛋白质合成相关基因表达

quote: s6k1 was down-regulated significantly and foxo1 and fbxo32 was up-regulated significantly at two meals per day (P
statement: 在每天两餐时，s6k1显著下调，而foxo1和fbxo32显著上调。
text_zh: 在每天两餐时，s6k1显著下调，而foxo1和fbxo32显著上调。
text_en: At two meals per day, s6k1 was significantly downregulated, while foxo1 and fbxo32 were significantly upregulated.
outcome: 蛋白质分解相关基因表达

quote: The expression levels of casr , gprc6a , and mglur4 were up-regulated at higher feeding frequency.
statement: 在较高的投喂频率下，casr、gprc6a和mglur4的表达水平上调。
text_zh: 在较高的投喂频率下，casr、gprc6a和mglur4的表达水平上调。
text_en: At higher feeding frequencies, the expression levels of casr, gprc6a and mglur4 were upregulated.
outcome: 氨基酸感应与代谢信号

quote: Thus, both high feeding frequency and protein blends enhanced amino acid sensing in gibel carp intestine.
statement: 因此，高投喂频率和蛋白质混合物均增强了银鲫肠道中的氨基酸感应。
text_zh: 因此，高投喂频率和蛋白质混合物均增强了银鲫肠道中的氨基酸感应。
text_en: Therefore, both high feeding frequency and protein mixture enhanced amino acid sensing in the intestine of gibel carp.
intervention: Higher feeding frequency with mixed protein sources

quote: Plasma FAA content was higher at four meals per day compared to two meals per day in the present trial.
statement: 在本试验中，每天四次投喂组的血浆游离氨基酸（FAA）含量高于每天两次投喂组。
text_zh: 在本试验中，每天四次投喂组的血浆游离氨基酸（FAA）含量高于每天两次投喂组。
text_en: In this trial, the plasma free amino acid (FAA) content in the group fed four times a day was higher than that in the group fed twice a day.

quote: Similarly, higher plasma EAA levels were reported 5 h postprandially of gibel carp fed at six meals per day compared to two meals per day (Zhao, 2014).
statement: 同样，据报道，与每天两次投喂相比，每天六次投喂的银鲫在餐后5小时的血浆必需氨基酸（EAA）水平更高。
text_zh: 同样，据报道，与每天两次投喂相比，每天六次投喂的银鲫在餐后5小时的血浆必需氨基酸（EAA）水平更高。
text_en: Similarly, it is reported that plasma essential amino acid (EAA) levels at 5 hours postprandial were higher in gibel carp fed six times a day compared to those fed twice a day.

quote: In addition, rainbow trout exhibited increased plasma FAA levels with higher feeding levels (Cleveland and Burr, 2011).
statement: 此外，虹鳟随着投喂水平的增加表现出血浆游离氨基酸（FAA）水平升高。
text_zh: 此外，虹鳟随着投喂水平的增加表现出血浆游离氨基酸（FAA）水平升高。
text_en: In addition, rainbow trout showed elevated plasma free amino acid (FAA) levels with increasing feeding levels.

quote: Similarly, dietary mixture of shrimp hydrolysate and plant proteins to replace 22% fishmeal increased SGR in largemouth bass (Li et al., 2021).
statement: 虾水解物和植物蛋白的日粮混合物替代22%的鱼粉增加了大口黑鲈的特异性生长率（SGR）。
text_zh: 虾水解物和植物蛋白的日粮混合物替代22%的鱼粉增加了大口黑鲈的特异性生长率（SGR）。
text_en: A dietary mixture of shrimp hydrolysate and plant protein replacing 22% of fish meal increased the specific growth rate (SGR) of largemouth bass.

quote: However, inappropriate protein source blends inhibited protein utilization and growth of aquaculture animals (Burr et al., 2012 ; Villanueva-Gutiérrez et al., 2020).
statement: 不适当的蛋白质来源混合物抑制了养殖动物的蛋白质利用率和生长。
text_zh: 不适当的蛋白质来源混合物抑制了养殖动物的蛋白质利用率和生长。
text_en: Inappropriate protein source mixtures inhibited the protein utilization and growth of farmed animals.

quote: At two meals per day, higher CF was found in fish fed diet 3.
statement: 在每天两餐的情况下，喂食日粮3的鱼表现出更高的饲料系数（CF）。
text_zh: 在每天两餐的情况下，喂食日粮3的鱼表现出更高的饲料系数（CF）。
text_en: With two meals per day, fish fed diet 3 showed a higher feed conversion ratio (FCR).

quote: The negative effect of diet 2 and the positive effect of diet 4 on growth were offset by enlarging feeding frequency from two to four meals per day.
statement: 将喂食频率从每天两餐增加到四餐抵消了日粮2对生长的负面影响和日粮4对生长的正面影响。
text_zh: 将喂食频率从每天两餐增加到四餐抵消了日粮2对生长的负面影响和日粮4对生长的正面影响。
text_en: Increasing the feeding frequency from two meals per day to four meals offset the negative effect of diet 2 on growth and the positive effect of diet 4 on growth.

quote: Similarly, it was reported that increasing the feeding frequency from two to four meals per day ameliorated poor feed utilization and asynchronous amino acid absorption issues when soybean meal replaced dietary fishmeal in gibel carp (Zhao, 2014).
statement: 据报道，当豆粕替代鲫鱼的日粮鱼粉时，将喂食频率从每天两餐增加到四餐改善了糟糕的饲料利用率和氨基酸吸收不同步的问题。
text_zh: 据报道，当豆粕替代鲫鱼的日粮鱼粉时，将喂食频率从每天两餐增加到四餐改善了糟糕的饲料利用率和氨基酸吸收不同步的问题。
text_en: It is reported that when soybean meal replaced fish meal in the diet of crucian carp, increasing the feeding frequency from two meals per day to four improved the problems of poor feed utilization and asynchronous amino acid absorption.
outcome: 饲料利用率与营养吸收

quote: Furthermore, the increase in the feeding frequency from two to four meals per day had no effect on the protein utilization of CM but enhanced the utilization of soybean meal, TMM, CAP, and CPC, promoting growth in grass carp (Xia, 2022).
statement: 此外，将喂食频率从每天两餐增加到四餐对CM的蛋白质利用率没有影响，但增强了豆粕、TMM、CAP和CPC的利用率，促进了草鱼的生长。
text_zh: 此外，将喂食频率从每天两餐增加到四餐对CM的蛋白质利用率没有影响，但增强了豆粕、TMM、CAP和CPC的利用率，促进了草鱼的生长。
text_en: In addition, increasing the feeding frequency from two meals per day to four had no effect on the protein utilization of CM, but enhanced the utilization of soybean meal, TMM, CAP and CPC, promoting the growth of grass carp.

quote: The heightened feed intake at four meals per day primarily drives growth enhancement, yet the short intervals compromise inferior feed utilization.
statement: 每日四餐增加摄食量从而促进生长，但短间隔损害了饲料利用率。
text_zh: 每日四餐增加摄食量从而促进生长，但短间隔损害了饲料利用率。
text_en: Four meals per day increased feed intake and thereby promoted growth, but the short interval impaired feed utilization.
outcome: 生长性能与饲料利用率

quote: Similar trends were also observed in gilthead seabream (Sparus aurata) (Basto-Silva et al., 2022), grass carp (Wu et al., 2021) and largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) (Liu et al., 2022).
statement: 在鲷鱼、草鱼和大口黑鲈中也观察到了类似的趋势。
text_zh: 在鲷鱼、草鱼和大口黑鲈中也观察到了类似的趋势。
text_en: Similar trends were also observed in sea bream, grass carp, and largemouth bass.

population.species: gilthead seabream; grass carp; largemouth bass

quote: Conversely, the augment of feeding frequency from one to four meals per day with satiated feeding promoted the growth of Schizothorax wangchiachii by increasing feed intake without affecting feed utilization (Wang et al., 2022).
statement: 相反，将齐口裂腹鱼的投喂频率从每日一次增加到四次并饱食投喂，通过增加摄食量促进了生长，且未影响饲料利用率。

quote: Fish were hand-fed to satiation once daily at 09:00 with commercial floating pellets (32% protein, 5% lipid; Tongwei®, Chengdu, China); uneaten food and faeces were siphoned out after 1 h.
statement: Fish were fed to satiation once daily with specific commercial pellets, and waste was removed after one hour.
text_en: Fish were fed to satiation once daily with specific commercial pellets, and waste was removed after one hour.

quote: Health was assessed twice daily (09:30 and 17:30) for body lesions, exophthalmia, buoyancy, opercular rate, and feeding response; any individual showing distress was immediately isolated and excluded.
statement: Fish health was monitored twice daily for specific indicators, and distressed individuals were isolated and excluded from the study.
text_en: Fish health was monitored twice daily for specific indicators, and distressed individuals were isolated and excluded from the study.
intervention_record: 每日健康评估并隔离异常鱼

quote: At study completion, all fish were humanely euthanised by immersion in aerated MS-222 (500 mg L⁻ 1 , buffered 1:1 with NaHCO₃) at 20 °C until 10 min after opercular movement ceased, followed by cervical transection, in accordance with the Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals promulgated by National Institutes of Health (NIH), 1996.
statement: Fish were euthanized using buffered MS-222 immersion followed by cervical transection according to NIH guidelines.
text_en: Fish were euthanized using buffered MS-222 immersion followed by cervical transection according to NIH guidelines.

quote: RCC, G 1 , and G 2 fry were transported to their destinations 3 days after hatching and kept in separate, aerated aquaculture net cages at 21–25 °C for 1 week.
statement: 鱼苗在孵化后3天被运输，并在充气网箱中于21-25°C条件下饲养一周。
text_zh: 鱼苗在孵化后3天被运输，并在充气网箱中于21-25°C条件下饲养一周。
text_en: Fish larvae were transported 3 days after hatching and reared for one week in aerated net cages at 21-25°C.
intervention: Net cage farming with temperature control
outcome: 早期存活率与环境适应性

quote: They were fed two boiled egg yolks per 40–60 thousand fry.
statement: 每4-6万尾鱼苗投喂两个煮熟的蛋黄。
text_zh: 每4-6万尾鱼苗投喂两个煮熟的蛋黄。

quote: The survival rate was calculated based on the total number of fry on the first and last days.
statement: 根据第一天和最后一天的鱼苗总数计算存活率。
text_zh: 根据第一天和最后一天的鱼苗总数计算存活率。
text_en: Survival rate was calculated based on the total number of fry on the first and last days.

quote: On day 11 post-hatching, RCC, G 1 , and G 2 were transferred to different ponds at a density of 120,000 fry/667 m 2 at each site.
statement: 孵化后第11天，鱼苗以每667平方米120,000尾的密度转入不同池塘。
text_zh: 孵化后第11天，鱼苗以每667平方米120,000尾的密度转入不同池塘。

quote: They were fed with plankton and 3–5 kg of soybean milk daily.
statement: 每天投喂浮游生物和3-5公斤豆浆。
text_zh: 每天投喂浮游生物和3-5公斤豆浆。
text_en: Feed plankton and 3-5 kg of soy milk daily.

quote: Twenty-one days later, subsamples of these fish were randomly selected and stocked at a density of 1800 fish/667 m 2 for the adult grow-out stage.
statement: 21天后，随机选取的子样本以每667平方米1800尾的密度投放至成鱼养殖阶段。
text_zh: 21天后，随机选取的子样本以每667平方米1800尾的密度投放至成鱼养殖阶段。
text_en: After 21 days, randomly selected subsamples were stocked into the grow-out phase at a density of 1800 fish per 667 square meters.

quote: These were fed with aquatic compound feed containing 32 % protein.
statement: 这些鱼被投喂含32%蛋白质的水产配合饲料。
text_zh: 这些鱼被投喂含32%蛋白质的水产配合饲料。
text_en: These fish were fed an aquaculture compound feed containing 32% protein.

quote: Temperature was kept at 20.0 ± 0.5 °C, pH 7.2–7.6, total ammonia-N ≤ 0.2 mg L⁻ 1 , nitrite-N ≤ 0.05 mg L⁻ 1 , and dissolved oxygen > 6.5 mg L⁻ 1 .
statement: 实验期间水温控制在20.0 ± 0.5 °C，pH值在7.2–7.6之间，总氨氮≤0.2 mg/L，亚硝酸盐氮≤0.05 mg/L，溶解氧>6.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 实验期间水温控制在20.0 ± 0.5 °C，pH值在7.2–7.6之间，总氨氮≤0.2 mg/L，亚硝酸盐氮≤0.05 mg/L，溶解氧>6.5 mg/L。
text_en: During the experimental period, water temperature was controlled at 20.0 ± 0.5 °C, pH was between 7.2–7.6, total ammonia nitrogen ≤0.2 mg/L, nitrite nitrogen ≤0.05 mg/L, and dissolved oxygen >6.5 mg/L.

population.system: 实验室循环水养殖系统

quote: Figure 1 A also shows the relationship between U and HBF and the equation ... provides a good fit to the data.
statement: 图1A展示了游泳速度（U）与心跳频率（HBF）之间的关系，且线性方程拟合良好。

text_en: Figure 1A shows the relationship between swimming speed (U) and heart beat frequency (HBF), with a good fit to the linear equation.

quote: Thus, we conclude that 70%-88% of U crit is the threshold range for efficient swimming and this provides practical guidance for setting flow velocities in fishways and habitat restoration projects that will enhance fish survival.
statement: 因此，我们得出结论，临界游泳速度的70%-88%是高效游泳的阈值范围，这为设定鱼道和栖息地恢复项目中的流速提供了实用指导，从而增强鱼类生存率。
text_zh: 因此，我们得出结论，临界游泳速度的70%-88%是高效游泳的阈值范围，这为设定鱼道和栖息地恢复项目中的流速提供了实用指导，从而增强鱼类生存率。
text_en: Therefore, we conclude that 70%-88% of critical swimming speed is the threshold range for efficient swimming, which provides practical guidance for setting flow velocities in fish passage and habitat restoration projects, thereby enhancing fish survival rates.
intervention_record: 基于临界游泳速度设定鱼道流速

quote: Given that prolonged anaerobic metabolism can negatively impact both fish health and swimming performance
statement: Prolonged anaerobic metabolism can negatively impact both fish health and swimming performance.
text_en: Prolonged anaerobic metabolism can negatively impact both fish health and swimming performance.

quote: Most specimens were released immediately at the same site after collecting blood or fin samples and sexing as described below.
statement: 大多数标本在采集血液或鳍样本并进行性别鉴定后被立即放归原采集地。
text_zh: 大多数标本在采集血液或鳍样本并进行性别鉴定后被立即放归原采集地。
text_en: Most specimens were immediately released back to their original collection site after blood or fin sampling and sex identification.

quote: Blood collected from the caudal vein with a small syringe was immediately preserved at -20°C in 99.5% ethanol.
statement: 使用小注射器从尾静脉采集的血液立即保存在-20°C的99.5%乙醇中。
text_zh: 使用小注射器从尾静脉采集的血液立即保存在-20°C的99.5%乙醇中。
text_en: Blood collected from the tail vein using a small syringe was immediately preserved in 99.5% ethanol at -20°C.

quote: The research findings introduce a more scientifically informed critical swimming speed, which could serve as a valuable guideline for fishway design, improving their efficacy and aiding in the restoration of fish habitats.
statement: 研究结果引入了更具科学依据的临界游泳速度，可作为鱼道设计的指导方针，以提高其效率并帮助恢复鱼类栖息地。
text_zh: 研究结果引入了更具科学依据的临界游泳速度，可作为鱼道设计的指导方针，以提高其效率并帮助恢复鱼类栖息地。
text_en: The research results introduce a more scientifically based critical swimming speed, which can serve as guidelines for fishway design to improve their efficiency and help restore fish habitats.
intervention_record: 基于临界游泳速度设定鱼道流速
outcome: 栖息地连通性与迁移能力

quote: These findings provide practical guidance for setting flow velocities in fishways and habitat restoration projects, which will enhance fish survival and improve the overall effectiveness of these conservation efforts.
statement: 这些发现为鱼道和栖息地恢复项目中的流速设置提供了实际指导，这将提高鱼类存活率并改善保护工作的整体效果。
text_zh: 这些发现为鱼道和栖息地恢复项目中的流速设置提供了实际指导，这将提高鱼类存活率并改善保护工作的整体效果。
text_en: These findings provide practical guidance for flow velocity settings in fish passage and habitat restoration projects, which will improve fish survival rates and enhance the overall effectiveness of conservation efforts.
intervention_record: 基于临界游泳速度设定鱼道流速

Mivel a

statement: Az ezüstkárász kihelyezése miatt a tavak túltelepítettek lettek, ami csökkentette a halak növekedési ütemét.
text_en: Az ezüstkárász kihelyezése miatt a tavak túltelepítettek lettek, ami csökkentette a halak növekedési ütemét.

statement: Azok a halak, amelyek nem versenyeztek az ezüstkárászokkal a táplálékért, jelentős növekedési előnyt értek el és tartottak fenn.

text_zh: 接种和攻毒后，CCL35.2/ORF25组表现出相对较高的免疫效力、更好的存活率和组织保护。
